Google 推出 Gemini Decisions API：不写回答只做判断，一次最多问 1000 个问题，输入每百万 Token 0.1 美元、输出不收钱

Google 今天在 Gemini API 里上线了 Decisions API，配套新模型 Gemini Decision
posts.quoted: Today we’re launching the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model in @GoogleAIStudio. Instead of generating text token by token, it’s built for closed-set choices scoring up to 1,000 questions across text, images, audio, video + PDFs in a single pass. A
